name: Jam
author: Lynli
summary: Your music. Up to four people. One Jam.
description: Create a Jam or join with a four-character invite. Share local audio over encrypted WebRTC data channels and listen together with synchronized playback.
privacy: Uses Supabase anonymous accounts and private Realtime channels for membership, clock synchronization and WebRTC signaling. Audio travels over encrypted peer connections. An optional TURN relay carries encrypted traffic when direct connections fail. Temporary received audio is deleted when a Jam ends; saving a song is your choice.

settings.title: STUN server
settings.description: Direct connections work without a TURN relay on compatible networks.

settings.title: Optional TURN relay
settings.description: Leave blank to use direct WebRTC. Example: turns:relay.example.com:5349
